fusions.name: Batting Swipe
fusions.desc: A heavy sidelong cut that deals 16 damage, knocks the target back 3.5 tiles and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Worse When Wounded
fusions.desc: A raking swing that deals 4 damage to everything within 2.5 tiles ahead of you. Its damage rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Weight Behind It
fusions.desc: Increases your slashing damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Prodded Too Often
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (163% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
